decision_rule: Admit a belief-learning objective only if the target dataset is P0-close, target-divergent, source-diverse, and uses deployable observations for the student while keeping hidden/capability values training-time only.
failure_criteria: dataset trains actor to read hidden parameters at deployment
dataset collapses to direct mu prediction as the primary target
dataset is built from one seed only or lacks source-diversity reporting
hypothesis: A capability-belief target surface focused on yaw/lateral/braking envelope and mass-geometry-sensitive causes will be more useful than passive input expansion or direct friction prediction for P0-close ambiguity.
success_criteria: consume M148/M150 P0-close pairs across at least three seeds
export a dataset or manifest of training-time capability targets
separate deployable student inputs from hidden/teacher target values
report target coverage for yaw response, lateral accel response, braking deceleration, and mass-geometry-sensitive cases
define the next objective-only sanity check without changing actor inputs
